newsitem.title: USA: Dayton Hudson sees Q1 above consensus.
newsitem.headline: Dayton Hudson sees Q1 above consensus.

text.p: Dayton Hudson Corp said Thursday it expects earnings for its first quarter ending May 3 to exceed analysts' consensus estimate of $0.33 a share.
In the year-ago first quarter Dayton Hudson earned $0.16 a share.

"Based on the strength of earnings at Target, we now expect to exceed analysts' current consensus earnings per share estimate of $0.33 for the first quarter," Dayton Hudson Chairman Bob Ulrich said in a statement.
Earlier, the retailer said its same-store sales for the five weeks ended April 5 were up 1.9 percent from a year ago.
Its Target division's total sales for the month were up 12.1 percent, and its same-store sales increased 3.5 percent.
